verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only adjacent building blocks. There is a reporting tool category (`list_transaction`, `get_merchant_insights` for ORDERS/SALES metrics), access to transaction details, and retrievable refunds and disputes through APIs. Nothing documents settlement or payout-to-bank reconciliation or itemized fee reports. missing for 10: settlement/bank-deposit reconciliation reports, itemized fee breakdowns, consolidated refund and chargeback line items in a reconciliation report, any downloadable settlement report documentation, independent corroboration.
